integrity: General statements follow from explicit Walsh identities, symmetric Weyl decomposition and spectral computation; no independent mathematical audit or claim of exhaustive priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for nondegenerate binary quadratic levels and real symmetric intensity lifting; it does not certify complex phase retrieval, arbitrary Boolean windows, or smaller measurement sets. Small-dimensional enumeration is corroboration only.
title: Binary quadratic level sets give fully injective real Gabor tomography, with a unique projective-design resonance
